episode.title: This GIANT OCTOPUS Is NOT Real

synopsis: On a soundstage a colossal octopus looms over a lone performer, until a hatch opens in its side and he climbs out of it while the crew applaud.

object_card.name: giant octopus practical prop
object_card.descriptor: a colossal deep-red giant Pacific octopus prop, its bulbous mantle rising three storeys high with pebbled rust-red skin, dense cream speckles and eight thick muscular arms lined with two rows of ivory suckers, built as a physical set piece standing in a shallow studio water tank.
object_card.framing: A locked-off view across the tank with the backs of two camera operators and their monitors in the foreground and the creature filling the upper frame.
object_card.anomaly_descriptor: The octopus is a built practical prop with a hinged access hatch set into the side of its mantle.

shots.prompt:
SHOT 1, THE THREAT ON SET. A film studio soundstage reads immediately: a tall green screen wall behind, crew in black along the far edge, and the backs of camera operators with two monitors in the foreground. One giant creature stands on the set and moves toward exactly one man, who backs away and keeps his eyes on the creature.

Inside a large film studio soundstage: a tall bright green screen wall fills the back of frame, an overhead lighting grid and scaffolding cross the top, and a dozen crew members in black stand along the far edge of a shallow water tank. In the immediate foreground, the backs of two camera operators and two camera monitors showing the shot occupy the bottom of frame. Standing in the tank in the middle of the set is a colossal deep-red giant Pacific octopus prop, its bulbous mantle rising three storeys high with pebbled rust-red skin, dense cream speckles and eight thick muscular arms lined with two rows of ivory suckers. A 30-year-old turkish man with warm olive skin, thick dark eyebrows, a full neatly groomed black beard and short dark hair, wearing a black wetsuit top stands waist deep in the water in front of it, looking up at the creature and stepping backwards as one huge arm swings slowly toward him and water sheets off it. Locked-off static camera, at 35mm, natural cinematic perspective, aperture f/4, balanced depth of field, controlled three-point studio lighting. Ambient sound only: sloshing water, studio air handling and distant crew movement.
shots.violation_observation: A three-storey octopus stands inside a studio water tank in front of a green screen with camera crew around it.

shots.prompt:
SHOT 2, THE PRACTICAL REVEAL. A hatch opens in the side of the creature's body and exactly one man climbs out of it down onto the set floor while the crew around him applaud, showing that the creature is a built practical prop rather than a living animal.

The same soundstage, the same green screen wall, the same crew and the same two camera monitors in the foreground. A rectangular hinged hatch swings open in the side of the octopus mantle, revealing a lit metal interior with handrails, and a 30-year-old Turkish man with warm olive skin, thick dark eyebrows, a full neatly groomed black beard and short dark hair, wearing a black wetsuit top climbs out through it and steps down a short ladder onto the wet set floor. The crew members around the tank clap and raise their hands. The octopus stays completely still, plainly a built prop. Locked-off static camera, at 35mm, natural cinematic perspective, aperture f/4, balanced depth of field, controlled three-point studio lighting. Ambient sound only: applause, dripping water and studio air handling.
shots.state_carry: Water still runs down the prop and the set floor stays wet from the previous shot.

music: a sparse low studio-tone bed: a soft sustained hum with one quiet rising swell that lands as the hatch opens, mostly negative space so the water and applause stay in front, opening with sound in its very first second.
